productFit.name: Manfrotto 055 Aluminum 3-Section Tripod with Horizontal Column (MT055XPRO3)
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker (manfrotto.com global-de): max height 170 cm, max height with centre column down 140 cm, min height 9 cm, closed length 61 cm, weight 2.5 kg, 3 leg sections, flip locks, 3/8" top screw; safety payload 20 kg under UNI/PdR 105:2021 (this matches the B&H 44 lb table figure; the post keeps the lower ~9 kg working load).
productFit.reason: Manfrotto sells it in the EU under the same model code (German maker page, EU dealers; amazon.nl sells the same ASIN in stock).

productFit.name: K&F Concept 90 inch Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker spec table: 230 cm max, 1620 mm (162 cm) without centre column, 10 kg load. EU Amazon listing of the same ASIN: 66.5 cm to 230 cm, 54 cm folded, 4 leg sections, 28 mm ball head, model T254A7+BH-28L.
productFit.reason: Same ASIN is listed on the German Amazon store as the K&F Concept 230 cm tripod (T254A7+BH-28L).

productFit.name: VICTIV 74 inch Camera Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: amazon.nl listing (same ASIN): 74 in / 188 cm, 19.5 in min, about 1.36-1.4 kg, 3 leg sections. Its load field (6.35 kg) disagrees with the maker page (9.5 lb), so the post keeps the lower 9.5 lb (4.3 kg).
productFit.reason: amazon.de lists a different Victiv 188 cm aluminium tripod (ASIN B0FR8MPJD8, 1.38 kg); no source confirms the exact US model B09KGS7HHH is sold in Germany.

productFit.name: CAMBOFOTO 74 inch Camera Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: amazon.nl listing (same ASIN): 20 to 188 cm, about 1.3 kg (1.27 kg in the spec table), 8.8 lb load (its text also says 4 kg), folded 20.47 in, 3 leg sections.
productFit.reason: amazon.de lists other CAMBOFOTO 188 cm tripods (e.g. B0CWLFJZS1 with a fluid head), not this exact gunmetal pan-head variant; no source confirms B0CQP46NQG is sold in Germany.

localFacts.fact: Destatis: the average man in Germany is 1.79 m tall (average woman 1.66 m), so a 6 ft (183 cm) reader is only a little above the German average; the eye-level maths of the post applies to many German men.

Lufthansa allows carry-on bags of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm. The Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 closes to 61 cm (maker), so it does not fit a standard cabin bag lengthwise; the K&F (54 cm folded) is just under 55 cm.
Kölner Dom (Domordnung §2): photos without flash for private purposes are allowed, but "Aufnahmen mit Stativen bedürfen einer Genehmigung durch den Dompropst"; bags only up to 40x35x15 cm.
Manfrotto's own German spec sheet gives the MT055XPRO3 140 cm with the centre column down and 170 cm with it up, the same figures German forum users quote.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall German beginners (190 cm) worry they must spend more and carry a bigger tripod to look through the viewfinder standing upright.
localPainPoints.fix: Use the column-down height rule (body height minus 25-30 cm); the K&F reaches 162 cm column down, the budget 188 cm tripods are light but load-limited.

localPainPoints.pain: Forum users warn against long, wobbly centre columns as the way to gain height.
localPainPoints.fix: Compare the column-down figure and keep the column down where possible (post sections on stability and centre column).

localPainPoints.pain: The Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 is known in German forums for only 140 cm working height without the column.
localPainPoints.fix: The post states 140 cm column down (about 152-160 cm at the viewfinder) and recommends the K&F for 1,93 m+.

Lufthansa cabin-bag limit 55 x 40 x 23 cm versus each tripod's folded length (Manfrotto 61 cm does not fit lengthwise).
Tripod rule at Kölner Dom (permission from the Dompropst needed).
German average height (Destatis 1.79 m men) to frame who needs a tall tripod.
